title: Three solid cards
text: Make 3 cards with checked quotes this week.

title: Explain two papers
text: Explain 2 papers in your own words, and pass the check.

title: Papers that disagree
text: Find 3 papers that disagree on the same point. Explain 3 links of the type "can be compared". Each link needs a checked quote in both PDFs.

title: The hardest paper, in simple words
text: Mark your hardest paper as a boss. Read it "like I am 12". Then pass the Feynman check on it.

title: Defeat a boss
text: Defeat a boss paper: answer its quiz and pass its Feynman check, both with 80% or more.

title: Water the garden
text: Do a review on 3 different days this week.

title: Ten reviews
text: Review 10 items of your garden this week.

title: Two hours of focus
text: Focus for 120 minutes this week, in sessions of 20 minutes or more.

title: Three wins
text: Write your win of the day on 3 days this week.

title: Cut the question
text: Cut your main question into 3 sub-questions.

title: A paper for each sub-question
text: Tag at least one paper to each of your sub-questions.

title: A first section
text: Write one section of your literature review.

title: The gap in 5 lines
text: Write the gap of your field in 5 lines.

title: Meet your supervisor
text: Send your supervisor pack this week.
